title: English Practice Quiz 0878
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: You notice two records show different dates for the same event. What is the best first step?
questions.explanation: Original records help establish which date is accurate.

questions.question: A problem keeps recurring. What should be examined?
questions.explanation: Root-cause analysis looks beyond symptoms to the underlying cause.

questions.question: A proposed solution has high cost and little benefit. It is likely:
questions.explanation: Low benefit relative to cost suggests poor value.

questions.question: Which statement is an assumption rather than a verified fact?
options: The visitor may have been angry because of the wait.
questions.explanation: May have been angry is an inference, not a directly verified fact.

questions.question: When information is incomplete, a sensible decision-maker should:
options: identify what is missing and seek reliable evidence
questions.explanation: Identifying gaps and gathering evidence improves decisions.

questions.question: A 'trade-off' occurs when:
options: gaining one benefit involves giving up another
questions.explanation: A trade-off balances competing benefits and costs.

questions.question: Which method helps compare several possible solutions?
A pilot test is conducted to:
options: try a process on a small scale before wider use
questions.explanation: A pilot tests feasibility and identifies issues before full rollout.

questions.question: A decision is 'reversible' if it can be:
questions.explanation: Reversible decisions can be changed if needed.

questions.question: After implementing a solution, you should:
options: monitor results to see whether it worked
questions.explanation: Monitoring confirms whether the solution achieved its goal.
